newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 19.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Six officers dismissed from the army for attempting to destabilise the institutions of the republic at the time of Ivory Coast's October 1995 presidential election; commission of enquiry for former army chief Robert Guei
- Health experts and donor representatives meet in capital Yamoussoukro to discuss 26 billion CFA project to improve health care in Ivory Coast

- Abidjan port seeks to double capacity of its Vridi container terminal, head of the port Jean Michel Moulod says in South Africa. Tenders likely to be invited after the end of November for $16 million project to build two new unloading gateways over the next two years.
- Education Minister Pierre Kipre announces imminent recruitment of 1,514 extra primary and secondary teachers
- Sanctions against soldiers accused of coup plot; a step towards the arrest of former army chief Robert Guei.
- African coffee producers meet in Ivory Coast look at ways of bolstering sagging world coffee prices
- Trawler owners in Abidjan's fishing port, accused of employing foreigners rather than Ivorians, say that Ivorians turn their noses up at certain jobs.
